questions.title: SELECT Star Meaning
questions.description: What does SELECT * FROM records; return?
questions.Option2: All rows but only text columns

questions.title: Clause Order Basics
questions.description: Which clause must come immediately after SELECT in a basic read query?

questions.title: Selecting Two Columns
questions.description: Which query returns only the columns title and artist from records?
questions.Option2: SELECT * FROM records WHERE title, artist;

questions.title: Purpose of AS
questions.description: In SELECT price AS usd_price, what does AS do?
questions.Option3: Renames the output column to usd_price

questions.title: DISTINCT Effect
questions.description: What does SELECT DISTINCT artist FROM records; guarantee?
questions.Option4: Each artist appears at most once

questions.title: Expression Header Names
questions.description: SELECT price * 1.08 FROM records; — what header does the result column get in SQLite?

questions.title: Alias Rule Check
questions.description: Which snippet correctly uses a table alias?
questions.Option2: SELECT title FROM records WHERE r;
questions.Option3: SELECT r.title FROM records AS r;
questions.codesnippet: SELECT r.title FROM records AS r;

questions.title: Expression Alias Output
questions.description: What is the header of the second column in the result of this snippet?
questions.codesnippet: SELECT title, stock * 2 AS doubled FROM records;

questions.title: DISTINCT Multi Column
questions.description: SELECT DISTINCT artist, released_year FROM records; removes duplicates based on what?

questions.title: Semicolon Necessity
questions.description: In SQLite, is the trailing semicolon required after a single SELECT statement?
questions.Option3: No — it is optional for a single statement

questions.title: Projection Best Practice
questions.description: Why prefer listing explicit columns over SELECT * in application code?
questions.Option2: Explicit columns survive schema changes and reduce data transfer

questions.title: Alias Visibility Scope
questions.description: In SQLite, where can a column alias defined in the SELECT list be referenced?
questions.Option1: In the WHERE clause of the same query
questions.Option2: In the ORDER BY clause of the same query

questions.title: DISTINCT + ORDER BY Combo
questions.description: What does this query output?
questions.Option1: Every artist once, by album count
questions.Option3: An error — DISTINCT and ORDER BY cannot combine
questions.codesnippet: SELECT DISTINCT artist AS artist FROM records ORDER BY artist;

questions.title: Expression Header Fix
questions.description: The query below shows an ugly expression header. Which change gives the computed column the clean name price_with_tax?
questions.Option2: Add AS price_with_tax after the expression

questions.title: Two Table Aliases
questions.description: A query joins records AS a and records AS b. Which SELECT list is well-formed?

questions.title: Star With Extras
questions.description: Is SELECT *, price FROM records; valid in SQLite?
questions.Option1: Yes — star expands to all columns, then price is appended (duplicated)

questions.title: Duplicate Alias Headers
questions.description: SELECT price AS price, stock AS price FROM records; — what does SQLite render as the two column headers?
questions.Option1: Both render as price — SQLite allows duplicate output names
questions.Option2: An error — duplicate alias names are rejected
questions.Option4: The second alias is auto-renamed to price:1

questions.title: DISTINCT With Original Column Sort
questions.description: SELECT DISTINCT released_year AS y FROM records ORDER BY released_year DESC; — why does this work despite aliasing to y?
questions.Option1: ORDER BY resolves the underlying column name when it exists
questions.Option3: SQLite rewrites aliases into WHERE clauses
questions.Option4: It fails — must use ORDER BY y

questions.title: Chained Multiplication
questions.description: For a record priced at exactly 20.0, what does this snippet return in the p column?
questions.codesnippet: SELECT price * 1.08 * 1.0 AS p FROM records WHERE price = 20.0;

questions.title: Function Expression Header
questions.description: Without an alias, which header does SQLite show for this snippet's only column?
